title: Minimum income threshold rejects submission with PolicyViolationException

scope_out: must not persist a partial application row on a refused submission; must not hardcode the minimum income value outside the policy version; must not charge a fee or penalty for a refused submission

operations.text:
1. Define `PolicyViolationException` in `backend/src/types/policy_violation.py` (new), subclassing `AppError` from `backend/src/types/errors.py` (owned by E15-S1, consumed not modified) with `threshold_kind: str`, `configured_value: str`, `submitted_value: str` and `status_code=422`; compose its message so the error response identifies `PolicyViolationException` (AC1) and names the breached threshold and the configured value it was checked against (AC2), matching the `PolicyViolation` shape in `specs/design/api-contracts.md`.
2. Define `guard_minimum_income(declared_income: Money, rules: PolicyRules, policy_version_id) -> None` in `backend/src/service/origination/income_guard.py` (new): raises `PolicyViolationException(threshold_kind="min_income", configured_value=str(rules.min_income), submitted_value=str(declared_income))` when `declared_income < rules.min_income`; pure comparison against the pinned `PolicyRules` (owned by E2-S1) — never a hardcoded threshold, no I/O.
3. Modify `backend/src/service/origination/intake.py` (owned by E4-S1, deepened by E4-S2) to call `income_guard.guard_minimum_income(applicant.declared_income, rules, policy_version_id)` immediately after resolving `rules` via `policy.active_policy_version` and before `ApplicationRepository.insert`, inside the same database transaction, so a raised `PolicyViolationException` propagates before any row is written and the transaction rolls back leaving no application (or checklist) row behind (AC3).
4. Add `backend/tests/integration/test_policy_violation_rollback.py` (new): integration tests submitting with `declared_income` below the selected product's pinned minimum-income threshold, asserting the error response identifies `PolicyViolationException` (AC1), the error body names `threshold_kind="min_income"` and the configured minimum value (AC2), and a subsequent query of the `application` table for that attempted submission returns no row (AC3) — covering AC1-AC3.
